name: TwilightOS 2026.11.28
body_html:
TwilightOS 2026.11.28: Arch Linux with a reworked KDE Plasma 6 desktop that feels familiar to Windows users.

Highlights

  • Dusk launcher, slim floating top bar, Quick Settings (Win+A), notifications, CPU/RAM monitor
  • Settings app with everything in-app: display, sound, Bluetooth, mouse and keyboard, network and VPN, accounts, privacy, time and language, accessibility
  • Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc), sign-out screen (Ctrl+Alt+Del), lock and sign-in screens with show-password
  • Setup, a step-by-step installer: btrfs with snapshots, themed GRUB boot menu, firewall on
  • Dark and light themes; the accent colour recolours the icons
  • About 840 MB of RAM and 0.0% CPU on an idle installed desktop (measured in a VM)

Install

  1. Download twilightos-2026.11.28-x86_64.iso (and the .sha256 file to check it: sha256sum -c twilightos-2026.11.28-x86_64.iso.sha256).
  2. Write it to a USB stick with Ventoy, Rufus (DD image mode) or dd.
  3. Turn Secure Boot off, start from the stick, and double-click Install TwilightOS on the desktop. Setup uses the whole disk you choose.

Windows apps: Wine is not on the ISO any more. Install it from Settings › Apps › Windows apps when you need it.

See the README for the full tour with screenshots.
